critical_code_review_comments: Path parameter inconsistency: /api/v1/vendors/{id} keys by UUID, but /api/v1/distributor-tiers/{code} keys by natural code (PATCH & DELETE). Distributors also use {id}. Consider unifying — either all-by-id or all-by-code — to reduce client surprise. Documented behaviour, not a bug, but worth normalising in Sprint 1.5.
Distributor `business_name` is a required field distinct from `legal_name`; both max 255. Docs and Postman examples should show both to prevent 422 on integration.
Auto-provisioning on GET /me/profile and GET /me/wallet is user-friendly but implicit — worth documenting in OpenAPI descriptions so clients don't assume 404 semantics.

Address label enum is fixed to ('billing','shipping','other') by regex pattern; if product roadmap includes 'home'/'work' labels, upgrade to Literal enum + migration now rather than later to avoid a breaking change.

mypy config (backend/mypy.ini) intentionally ignores tests/, migrations/, app.models.*, app.db.* untyped-def restrictions — this is documented as Sprint 1.1 baseline; consider tightening tier-by-tier per S1.5 debt item TD-0X. Running `mypy --strict app` still surfaces 92 residuals (mostly missing return-type annotations on FastAPI route handlers) — not a gate failure but the sprint claim of 'mypy-strict clean' should be phrased as 'mypy clean under project config' to avoid ambiguity.
validation_handler fix confirmed: whitespace vendor code returns 422 with error.code='validation_error' and JSON-serialisable details (jsonable_encoder path exercised) — no crash.
RBAC guard on /vendors returns rbac.forbidden (403) with the specific missing permission (`purchase.read`) surfaced in details — good observability.
